title: Replace an ideal zero-temperature derivative with a finite whole-box inverse
statement: Distinct endpoint continuant numerator degrees give rank at 3n-2 positive candidate shifts. On the selected rows the exact transformed variance map G=L y has ||DG-I||_infinity<=q<1 throughout the coefficient box. This yields global injectivity and a clipped exact-map contraction; finite inexact iterations obey A q^k+(s+e)/(1-q).

requires: Known SPD K and qualified curvature floors; endpoint-chain theorem or actual full-rank frame qualification
Quartics in [0,A]^n, calibrated uniform shifts and a common sufficiently small positive temperature
Actual simultaneous variance intervals and exact or outward-qualified receiver arithmetic
provides: A finite-temperature identifiability and bounded-data coefficient interface
assumptions: Arbitrary cyclic SPD matrices need separate frame qualification
Only n selected scalar variances are physically needed, with their full read costs
No convergence or unique fixed point for an arbitrary approximate forward map is inferred
costs: Known-K resolvents, finite Wick coefficient compilation and forward error; all measurement, calibration, stationarity and settling costs
Four-node example: 10 frame plus 4 forward resolvents, 348 Wick states; no physical reads or fitted coefficient certificate acquired
contract.units: Native mechanical stiffness, temperature, variance and quartic coefficient units from the supplied Gibbs model; no automatic SI-time or device calibration conversion.
contract.obstruction: Affine local rank or a derivative oracle does not supply a finite-temperature global receiver.

body: Known physical K, mechanical Gibbs bath/metric, shifts, temperature, calibration, initialization and stationary observation are supplied. No variance observations or inverse iterations on data occurred. The roughly 1.3e37 sufficient read plan is not a lower bound, optimality result or economical instrument. A uniformly accurate approximate forward map is not automatically contractive. Changes in K/temperature/frame need their own propagation. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.

review.scope: Acquired completed substantive independent whole proof/code review with actual source/receipt versions. Acceptance covers exact finite-temperature global inverse, finite forward operator and conditional statistics. Physical acquisition and practical advantage remain separate.
